teaser.en: The 'big rib plant' is used against convulsions that are said to grip the rib cage.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mkubwa wa mbavu' hutumika dhidi ya degedege linalosemekana kubana mbavu.

summary.en: *Mbavubavu mkulu* is a bush shrub of the Grewia family with three-veined leaves and small lobed fruits. Its name, 'rib plant', matches its use against convulsions affecting the ribs.
summary.sw: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni kichaka cha vichakani cha jenasi ya *Grewia*, chenye majani yenye mishipa mitatu na matunda madogo yenye mapande. Jina lake, 'mmea wa mbavu', linalingana na matumizi yake dhidi ya degedege linaloathiri mbavu.

about.en: *Mbavubavu mkulu* is a shrub with leaves marked by three main veins running from the base, a typical Grewia feature. Its small fruits are lobed, like a few tiny berries fused together.
about.sw: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni kichaka chenye majani yaliyo na mishipa mikuu mitatu inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani, sifa ya kawaida ya *Grewia*. Matunda yake madogo yana mapande, kama vitunda vidogo vichache vilivyoungana.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and on forest edges.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu.

uses.en: It is used to treat *nyuni wa mbavu*, convulsions that affect the rib cage.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu *nyuni wa mbavu*, degedege linaloathiri mbavu.

culture.en: *Mbavubavu* means 'rib plant', a name tied directly to the illness it treats. The Digo distinguish two: this is *mbavubavu mkulu*, the big one, while the small form, *mbavubavu mdide*, is a different plant, *Premna resinosa*.
culture.sw: *Mbavubavu* lina maana ya 'mmea wa mbavu', jina linalohusiana moja kwa moja na ugonjwa unaoutibu. Wadigo wanatofautisha aina mbili: huu ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, mkubwa, wakati aina ndogo, *mbavubavu mdide*, ni mmea mwingine, *Premna resinosa*.

names.en: The Digo name is *mbavubavu mkulu*, or simply *mbavubavu*, which is shared with Giriama and Duruma. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. The Mgombato dictionary gives *m'bavu-bavu* for another plant, *Clerodendrum capitatum*, so the name may cover more than one species.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, au kwa ufupi *mbavubavu*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kigiriama na Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *m'bavu-bavu* kwa mmea mwingine, *Clerodendrum capitatum*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha spishi zaidi ya moja.

reason.en: Premna chrysoclada, from the Premna group
Dombeya, another bush shrub of the mallow family
reason.sw: *Dombeya*, kichaka kingine cha vichakani cha familia ya mibamia
